verdict.rationale: Jan's settings docs explicitly let users import local GGUF files via "Import Model". Its local inference is powered by llama.cpp, and it can download models from Hugging Face by ID, which together cover loading and running GGUF models. Missing for 10: detailed GGUF documentation (quant variant selection, supported quant types, per-model load parameters) and independent hands-on corroboration of GGUF imports.
